Experiences

Journey Inspiration

Four curated journeys showing the breadth of what Madagascar offers — from a relaxed island week to a 10-day sailing expedition aboard Luna Moon.

Signature VoyageSailing
10 Days

Cruising Expedition — Nosy Be to Mahajanga

Step aboard Luna Moon, our 115-year-old historic top-sail schooner, and sail Madagascar’s wild northwest coastline from the islands of Nosy Be to the cultural richness of Mahajanga. Remote anchorages, extraordinary marine life and barefoot luxury under the stars.

Nosy BeRussian BayNosy IranjaRadama IslandsNosy LavaBaie de MorambaMahajanga
View day by day
IslandsRelaxed
7 Days

Nosy Be Escape

The perfect introduction to Madagascar’s islands. One base, endless discovery — snorkelling with whale sharks, lemurs on Nosy Komba and the iconic Iranja sandbar.

Nosy BeNosy KombaNosy IranjaTanikely
View day by day
NorthAdventure
14 Days

Madagascar Adventure — Diego Suarez & Nosy Be

Explore Madagascar’s dramatic far north — tsingy formations, the Emerald Sea and Sakalava Bay — before returning to the islands of Nosy Be and the iconic Nosy Iranja sandbar.

Nosy BeAnkaranaDiego SuarezEmerald SeaNosy IranjaNosy Komba

14 Days

Madagascar Discovery Tour

The broadest possible sweep of Madagascar in two weeks — from the highland capital and the Avenue of the Baobabs to the island paradise of Nosy Be, Nosy Iranja and Nosy Komba.

Tours & Excursions

Standalone Experiences

Every tour below can stand alone or be woven into a bespoke itinerary. Filter by type to find what moves you.

Marine

Whale Shark Excursion

Nosy Be

Snorkel alongside the world's largest fish in the warm waters off Madagascar's northwest coast.

Seasonal: October to December
Marine

Snorkelling with Sea Turtles

Nosy Be — Nosy Sakatia

Close encounters with resident green sea turtles in the calm, crystal-clear bays of Nosy Sakatia.

Marine

Tanikely Marine Reserve

Nosy Be

Snorkel in one of Madagascar's most beautiful protected marine reserves. Vibrant coral reefs, tropical fish and a historic lighthouse.

Marine

Nosy Iranja Day Trip

Nosy Be

Cruise to the iconic twin islands joined by a white sandbar at low tide. Swimming, snorkelling and pristine beaches.

Wildlife

Nosy Komba Lemur Tour

Nosy Be — Nosy Komba

Guided walk through lush forest where semi-wild black lemurs roam freely. Visit local villages and browse the handicraft market.

Wildlife

Lokobe Night Walk

Nosy Be — Lokobe Reserve

Step into one of Madagascar's last lowland rainforests. Night walks reveal chameleons, nocturnal lemurs and rare endemic species.

Wildlife

Ankarana Special Reserve

Diego Suarez

A spectacular limestone massif with underground rivers, caves and razor-sharp tsingy. Rich in lemurs, bats and reptiles.

Culture

Nosy Be Island Tour

Nosy Be

Colourful local markets, volcanic lakes, panoramic viewpoints at Mont Passot and the island's sacred trees.

Culture

Mahajanga & Katsepy Village

Mahajanga

Explore Mahajanga's lively waterfront, baobab-lined promenade and the rustic fishing village of Katsepy — home to crowned sifaka lemurs.

Adventure

Horse Riding Adventure

Nosy Be

Guided horseback rides along scenic beaches or forest trails. A unique perspective on Nosy Be's natural beauty.

Adventure

Quad Biking Excursion

Nosy Be

Off-road adventure through rural landscapes, villages and hidden coastal trails.

Adventure

Tsingy Rouge Park

Diego Suarez

Surreal red laterite rock formations sculpted by erosion — unlike anywhere else in Madagascar. Best after rainfall.

Adventure

Emerald Sea Sailing

Diego Suarez

Reach the breathtaking Mer d'Émeraude by traditional sailboat. Swim and snorkel in the protected turquoise lagoon.

Adventure

Avenue of the Baobabs

Morondava

Madagascar's most iconic landscape — towering centuries-old baobabs lining a dusty road. Best at sunrise or sunset.

Adventure

Tsingy de Bemaraha

Morondava

UNESCO World Heritage Site. Dramatic limestone pinnacles, suspension bridges and hidden canyons with endemic wildlife throughout.

Adventure

Mangrove Tours — Kivalo

Morondava

Navigate winding coastal waterways by traditional pirogue. Rich birdlife and a fascinating glimpse into Madagascar's coastal ecosystem.
